title: Antibiotics, Vaccines and Hygiene
summary: How Fleming found penicillin, why antibiotics don’t cure colds, antibiotic resistance, and why handwashing matters.

ib.note: Immunity and vaccines are developed further in Unit 6

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe
Curiosity Ch 3: Health: The Ultimate Treasure (antibiotics, antibiotic resistance, hygiene)

objectives: I can explain what antibiotics do and why they don’t work against viruses.
I can explain how antibiotic resistance develops and how to prevent it.
I can explain how hygiene and vaccination prevent disease.
misconceptions: You can stop taking antibiotics when you feel better.
Rinsing hands with water is as good as washing with soap.
